jobs.title: AI-native Product Manager
jobs.description: #### About ShortPoint ShortPoint is a design software company that helps teams build beautiful intranet sites inside Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and Microsoft Teams. We are a remote-first, globally distributed team certified as a Great Place to Work and ranked #4 out of 15 Best Workplaces in Technology in the GCC, with regional offices in Dubai, Lviv, Ann Arbor, and London. We believe teamwork makes the dream work, and we keep our teams in sync and winning at scale. We are looking for a meticulous, proactive, and technically grounded Technical Product Manager to join our product team and work directly with our Product Director to keep our product engine running with precision and a great eye for design. #### Role Overview We are seeking a hands-on Technical Product Manager to support the Product Director across the full product lifecycle. You will run and manage product meetings, turn ideas and discussions into clear, well-written user stories, create mockups with the help of modern AI tools, and keep everyone informed on the status of upcoming releases. The ideal candidate combines strong product craft with genuine design sensibility and a solid technical foundation: you can follow engineering discussions with ease, reason about APIs and architecture, and dig into technical details when the situation calls for it. The stronger your technical depth, the better. You will bridge the gap between engineering, UI/UX design, and business priorities, and you should be comfortable working AI-first across your daily workflow. #### Key Responsibilities - Product Execution: Assist with the day-to-day product cadence alongside the Product Director, from meeting management and follow-ups through backlog grooming, story writing, and release tracking - Story Writing: Write detailed, unambiguous user stories and acceptance criteria in Linear, and keep the backlog organized and sprint-ready - Release Communication: Track release progress across engineering and QA, and proactively inform stakeholders of status, risks, and timelines - AI-Assisted Design: Create wireframes and mockups using AI design and prototyping tools, and apply a strong eye for UI/UX to keep the product intuitive and polished (you will be asked to demonstrate this in the interview) - AI Process Improvement: Being able to contribute to our processes by utilizing AI (Claude/ChatGPT work) to analyze data, close gaps, and resolve bottlenecks. #### Required Qualifications & Experience ⚠️ Mandatory Screening Criteria: Candidates who do not meet the experience and background requirements below will not be considered. - Total Experience: Minimum of 3 years of hands-on product management experience specifically within software/SaaS environments - Industry Background: Must have direct experience working on B2B SaaS products; familiarity with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, or intranet products is a strong plus - Tools & Ecosystems: Advanced, hands-on proficiency with Linear (or a similar agile tracking tool), GitHub, and Claude (CLI and app) or comparable AI tooling - Design Literacy: Strong eye for design, foundational knowledge of UI/UX workflows, and proven ability to produce mockups with AI-assisted tools - Technical Foundation: A solid technical background with strong software development familiarity; able to hold your own in discussions about APIs, web technologies, and architecture with engineers. Deeper hands-on experience, such as with JavaScript/React or the Microsoft 365/SharePoint ecosystem, is a significant advantage - Include the word 'compass' in your application response to confirm you have read this posting carefully. - Big Plus: A Claude Code or Codex project of your own that you can showcase and explain in the interview - Location: Fully remote role; work from anywhere with reasonable overlap with the team

jobs.title: QA Engineer: AI-Assisted Testing
jobs.description: Join ECFX, a company transforming how the legal industry works through technology. Every day our platform pulls court notices and legal documents from hundreds of court portals and e-filing systems, categorizes them with AI, and delivers them into our customers’ document and case management systems. When something is late, dropped, or misfiled, a law firm can miss a deadline. We’re looking for a hands-on QA Engineer who loves finding what others miss, and who uses AI to do it faster and deeper. Our engineers build with AI coding agents, so changes arrive quickly and in volume. You’ll be the person who works out what could break and tests it thoroughly by hand, using AI as your co-pilot for test design, test data, investigation, and reporting. This is a testing role first. If you also enjoy building automation, there’s room to use AI to create targeted automated checks where they pay off. You will have a real say in how we build, test, and ship software. What You’ll Engage In Test Smarter with AI: Use AI tools (such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, or ChatGPT) to read tickets, merge requests, and code diffs; map out risks and edge cases; draft test charters and checklists; and decide where to focus. You bring the judgment about what matters. Explore and Uncover: Run risk-based exploratory, functional, and regression testing across our Vue dashboard, admin tools, email notifications, and integrations. Find defects before customers do. Validate What Matters Most: Make sure documents are retrieved, parsed, categorized, stored, and delivered correctly across many external sources: court portals, 2FA/OTP logins, and integrations such as Clio, Filevine, iManage, and NetDocuments. Hunt for silent failures, where a document is dropped but the run reports success. Test Below the UI: Much of our work has no screen to click. Verify backend and platform changes by hand, using API calls, SQL queries, logs, and dashboards (Grafana/Loki, Sentry), with AI helping you write the queries and make sense of the output. Build Realistic Test Scenarios: Use AI to generate test data, sample court notice emails, and edge-case documents, and drive our simulators and test environments to reproduce hard-to-reach situations. Test Our AI Features: Evaluate our AI document categorization and our LLM-facing tools (an MCP server used by AI assistants). Build sample sets, check accuracy and consistency, try to break them with unusual or hostile inputs, and flag when a model or prompt change makes results worse. Guard Security and Access: Check logins (password, SAML SSO, OAuth), user roles and permissions, and that one firm can never see another firm’s data. Verify security fixes without breaking what already works. Reproduce and Triage: Investigate customer-reported and production issues, reproduce them reliably, and write bug reports clear enough that an engineer, or an AI agent, can act on them right away. Automate Where It Pays Off (Optional): If automation is in your toolkit, use AI to create focused automated checks, such as Playwright scripts or API checks, for high-risk flows you find yourself retesting. Agile Collaboration: Work with engineers and product managers in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives. Help write testable acceptance criteria and raise quality risks early What You’re Likely to Bring Professional Experience: 3 to 7 years in software quality assurance for web or SaaS applications, with deep experience in exploratory and manual testing of complex, data-heavy systems. AI Fluency ·You use AI assistants in your testing every day and can give concrete examples: generating test ideas and edge cases, building test data, writing SQL or log queries, summarizing logs or diffs, reproducing bugs, and drafting clear reports. Skill at prompting and giving context, such as feeding in the ticket, the diff, and the acceptance criteria to get useful output instead of generic answers. Healthy skep

jobs.title: Associate Forward-Deployed Product Manager
jobs.description: About Tailor Tailor is a pioneer in Headless ERP technology. Our platform empowers companies to build internal workflows that adapt to their unique needs — faster, smarter, and developer-first. About the Role We’re looking for an Associate Forward-Deployed Product Manager to own the day-to-day execution of live client implementations. You’ll be the first line of communication with our clients and the person keeping the project moving — coordinating directly with the internal development team, tracking progress and blockers, running testing and training, and making sure what was committed is what gets delivered. You’ll work collaboratively with the Account Manager and Senior PM (Forward-Deployed Product Manager), who own the commercial relationship and solution design; you own the execution. This is a development role designed to grow into the Senior PM role. Progression is based on performance and can be accelerated accordingly. What You’ll Do Own Day-to-Day Client Communications — Manage day-to-day client communications, including question handling, escalation management, and requests to the client, keeping clients informed and unblocked. Drive Project Execution & Tracking — Run the execution rhythm of the project: coordinate with the internal development team, maintain project management tools (e.g., GitHub Projects, Jira), and keep status, documentation, and release notes current for internal and client teams. Client Data & Gap Analysis — Analyze client data to surface gaps, discrepancies, and risks, and support the Senior PM and engineering in solution architecture and functional gap analysis. Testing, Coordination & Go-Live Prep — Validate every release before it reaches the client, coordinate client testing and sign-off, and own go-live readiness. Testing is how we protect client trust — it is a core part of this role. Client Training & Enablement — Create training materials and deliver training so client teams are set up to operate the platform independently. Influence the Platform Roadmap — Develop deep knowledge of the Tailor platform and translate client feedback into product insights that inform the roadmap. What We’re Looking For 2–5 years of experience in product management in either big tech or a startup, and/or management consulting experience; management consulting strongly preferred Proven customer-facing experience, comfortable in front of both technical and non-technical stakeholders Sharp, structured thinker who is comfortable with ambiguity and eager to learn and grow Ownership mindset with an appetite for operational and technical detail Exceptional written and verbal communication skills Comfortable with data analysis tools and AI-driven workflows Nice to Have You build things in your spare time — show us a side project you’ve vibe coded and walk us through how you approached it Exposure to ecommerce or physical-product operations — order, inventory, purchasing, fulfillment, or accounting workflows Familiarity with ERP, 3PL, or commerce platforms Prior experience onboarding customers onto software Compensation & Benefits Salary: USD 100,000 to USD 130,000 yearly Benefits: Health, dental, vision, flexible PTO, and more Why Tailor? You’ll work directly with the product team on a fast-growing platform solving real operational pain. If you love being the voice of the customer, reducing friction, and making teams more effective — let’s talk. Apply now and help us shape the future of Headless ERP.

Execution & Delivery: Strong track record of owning day-to-day execution, managing Jira/GitHub project tracking, backlog grooming, and keeping releases moving.
Rigorous Testing & QA: Deep hands-on QA background (test cases, API integration testing, release validation) matches the job's strong emphasis on protecting client trust through testing.
Customer-Facing: Proven experience gathering requirements directly from clients, translating vague requests into structured specs, and managing client communication.

jobs.description: AI Product Manager, Open Agentic Open Agentic is where we're building the next generation of AI products for insurance — products that can reshape how insurance is distributed, understood and managed. Through partnerships with brands including Avios and MoneySuperMarket, we already have AI products live in the market with household names. We're hiring two AI Product Managers to help us 10x the pace. You'll work directly with the Director of Product, Open Agentic, on some of the highest-profile products in the company, with significant autonomy and end-to-end ownership. You'll build to prove an idea with working prototypes, then work with our engineering team to take it into production. Think startup within a startup: high agency, high visibility, very little bureaucracy and lots of room to grow. What you'll do This is a hands-on product role — as much about deciding what to build as building it. You'll work across product thinking, prototyping, engineering, AI, UX and deployment rather than owning one narrow part of the stack. Current Open Agentic product areas include: Global Product Graph, our structured intelligence layer for insurance products. Companion, our consumer-facing AI agent. Today it guides customers through buying insurance. Before long, it should let them put their insurance on autopilot. AI distribution, including ChatGPT Apps, MCP quote integrations and partner deployments. Agentic Safety Platform, which helps companies evaluate, monitor and manage customer-facing AI deployments. We don't expect these to be the only things you'll work on. Part of the role is helping us discover and build what comes next. You'll: Take ambiguous product ideas and turn them into working software. Decide what to build now, what to defer and what not to build at all. Ship quickly, get things in front of real users and iterate on what you learn. Own products beyond the prototype — from zero to one, then from one to 100. Talk to customers and partners to find the problem worth solving, not just to validate a solution. Own the Global Product Graph — the ontology, the data, and the workflows that keep it accurate. Develop the insurance intelligence on top of it: product scoring, compliance evaluations, and what "good" means for a regulated AI deployment. Help shape both what Open Agentic builds and how we build it. Within your first three months, we'd like you to have taken meaningful ownership of an AI-native product and shipped it. Within six months, to be owning a major product or workstream end-to-end and taking it towards real customer adoption and revenue. Who we're looking for We're looking for builders — people who get excited by a blank page, move quickly and naturally take ownership when something needs doing. You'll probably have an engineering or computer science background and be able to build things yourself, but your ambitions sit in product: more interested in whether we're building the right thing than in owning the system that runs it. You're probably more excited by the product and commercial applications than by perfecting the engineering, and you want the next few years to grow your product and commercial mind rather than your engineering craft. You can build. You should be able to show us something you've personally built and deployed — we don't care whether it has 1 user (you) or 10 million — and explain how it works and the trade-offs you accepted. We're not asking you to own production systems. We are asking that you can prove an idea without needing a team. You have product judgment. You start from the problem and who has it, not the feature. You're opinionated about what to build, comfortable arguing for what to leave out, and you can say how you'd know whether it worked. You notice when something feels bad — good UX, design and clear communication matter to you alongside good engineering — and you care whether people actually use the thing, not only whether the You're AI-native. More than 2,000 companies worldwide, from ambitious mid-sized businesses to global enterprises, rely on Jedox to streamline planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes. At Jedox, we believe in innovation, impactful results, people centricity, and the power of #OneTeam to help our customers succeed. Your Responsibilities As Product Manager – Platform Experience & Cloud Administration, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of key platform experiences including navigation, onboarding, user access, and cloud administration. Working closely with Engineering, Design, and Architecture, you will drive improvements that enhance usability, customer trust, and platform scalability, helping shape how thousands of users experience Jedox every day. What You'll Do Own the product strategy and roadmap : Define and drive the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for Platform Navigation, BaseUI, and Cloud Console capabilities. Lead discovery and product validation: Conduct user research, gather stakeholder input, analyze customer needs, and validate opportunities to ensure impactful product investments. Shape the platform experience: Improve navigation, onboarding, login experiences, session management, and integrations with platform services such as analytics and feature flagging solutions. Drive Cloud Console evolution: Enhance the self-service administration experience, enabling IT teams to efficiently manage environments, users, permissions, and access controls. Manage end-to-end product delivery: Guide initiatives from concept through delivery, launch, and communication while ensuring high-quality execution and measurable outcomes. Prioritize and make trade-offs: Balance customer needs, technical complexity, business priorities, and long-term platform goals to make informed product decisions. Partner with Engineering and Architecture: Collaborate closely with technical leaders to align short-term delivery with sustainable platform architecture and scalability. Enable cross-functional alignment: Work with Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Leadership teams to build shared understanding and drive successful execution. Monitor product success: Define key outcomes, measure adoption and user experience improvements, and continuously optimize platform capabilities. Champion customer-centric innovation: Ensure platform experiences support both end users and IT administrators while strengthening customer trust and satisfaction. What Success Looks Like in Your First Year Administrators can complete common configuration and management tasks independently without requiring support tickets. Time-to-value for new users is significantly reduced through enhanced onboarding and navigation experiences. A clear, credible multi-year platform roadmap is established and supported by Engineering, Sales, and Leadership stakeholders. Your Profile At least 3 years of experience as a Product Manager within enterprise SaaS environments. Experience owning and developing foundational product areas such as platform services, administrative experiences, developer portals, or similar infrastructure-related products. Strong understanding of the needs of both IT buyers/administrators and end users. Proven ability to define product strategy, prioritize initiatives, and drive execution in complex, cross-functional environments. Ability to build trust with engineering teams through clear problem definition, structured thinking, and pragmatic decision-making. QA engineering work. Before anything ships, you’ll verify it does what the ticket said it would. Join us on our mission to profitably decarbonize buildings. The Role We’re seeking a Founding Product Manager to join our technology team. This high-impact, high-visibility role is perfect for someone who thrives on building from scratch: someone who can create structure where there isn’t any, build conviction with incomplete information, and operate as a partner to our internal team and customers . You’ll be Lumen’s first dedicated PM, which means you won’t be inheriting a mature roadmap, an existing research practice, or a PM org to plug into. You’ll be defining what product management looks like here, with the autonomy, access, and trust to do it. What You’ll Do Own and evolve a prioritized product roadmap for Lumen’s commercial solar and storage marketplace, informed by real user feedback, business priorities, and clear success metrics. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table. Instacart is a Flex First team There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. Why this role is on the menu The Customer Experience (CX) organization at Instacart is focused on making every interaction effortless, empathetic, and effective for our customers, shoppers, and partners. Our Knowledge team, spanning Knowledge Strategy, Content Operations, and Learning & Development, designs the programs, processes, and content that enable CX teams to deliver consistently excellent support at scale. We are looking for a Knowledge Program Manager who will support the planning, coordination, and execution of programs across our unified Knowledge function. In this role, you will work alongside Program Managers and cross-functional stakeholders like CX Leaders, Operations, Quality, and Vendors to keep programs moving, track deliverables, manage intake and prioritization workflows, and ensure cross-functional partners stay aligned. You will thrive in this role if you are highly organized, comfortable in a fast-moving environment, and energized by connecting the dots between multiple workstreams to drive progress on things that matter. What you’ll cook up in your first year Support the end-to-end execution of knowledge and learning programs (e.g., onboarding, upskilling, content launches, process rollouts) by managing timelines, tracking milestones, and coordinating across stakeholders. Manage and maintain program operating rhythms — including Jira intake boards, sprint tracking, launch calendars, and stakeholder communications — to keep work visible and on track. Serve as a point of contact for cross-functional partners submitting requests, triaging incoming work through the intake process and routing to the right function (Knowledge Strategy, Content Operations, or Learning & Development). Partner with subject matter experts, instructional designers, and knowledge strategists to gather inputs, track dependencies, and flag risks before they become blockers. Draft and distribute program communications, status updates, and launch readiness materials for internal stakeholders and CX leaders. Use program data — sprint velocity, backlog health, completion rates, and stakeholder feedback — to surface trends, report on program health, and support continuous improvement. The secret ingredients we’re looking for Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications) 2–4 years of experience in Program Management, Project Management, Learning & Development, Knowledge Management, or a related field, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously. Proven ability to coordinate cross-functional work across teams with different priorities, timelines, and ways of working. jobs.description: Unser Projekt für Dich: moebel.de ist eines der führenden Online-Shoppingportale für Möbel und Einrichtung in Europa. Unser neues Projekt Piqit ist ein KI-gestützter Shopping-Assistant, der die Art und Weise verändert, wie Menschen online Produkte finden und kaufen. Piqit berät den Nutzer interaktiv und findet passende Produkte aus über 100 Millionen Angeboten , vergleicht Preise über zahlreiche Shops hinweg und führt direkt zum passenden Anbieter – von Wein und Werkzeug über Elektronik und Haushaltsgeräte bis hin zu Beauty, Schmuck und Möbeln. Dafür suchen wir dich als Product Manager AI Search (m/w/d) . Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben Vom ersten Tag an mittendrin statt nur dabei: Du verantwortest die Antwortqualität von Piqit, unserem KI-gestützten Shopping-Assistant, der aus über 100 Millionen Angeboten das passende Produkt findet – und zwar von der ersten Beobachtung bis zur ausgerollten Änderung. Qualität heißt hier nicht Treffermenge, sondern Antwort: Du prüfst, ob Piqit verstanden hat, worum es geht, ob die vorgeschlagenen Produkte wirklich die richtigen sind und ob die Einordnung dazu trägt. Ursachenforschung ist deine Kerndisziplin: Wenn eine Antwort nicht überzeugt, unterscheidest du sicher, ob die passenden Produkte gar nicht gefunden wurden, ob in den Produktdaten ein Attribut fehlt oder falsch belegt ist oder ob das Modell aus guten Daten etwas Falsches gemacht hat. Du kennst die Eigenheiten von Sprachmodellen: stark bei Absicht, Nuance und Sprache, unzuverlässig bei exakten Zahlen, Vollständigkeit und Aktualität – und dabei immer überzeugend klingend. Genau dieses Gespür bringst du in jede Entscheidung ein. Hands-on statt Konzeptpapier: Prompt-Sets, Hints und Regeln schreibst und rollst du selbst aus, Attribute und Facetten schärfst du selbst nach, Testsets baust du selbst – und wiederkehrende Handgriffe automatisierst du weg, gern KI-gestützt. Du misst, was wirkt: Einzelfälle sind kein Beleg, dieselbe Anfrage kann zweimal unterschiedlich beantwortet werden. Du prüfst gegen eine feste Sammlung von Testanfragen und bewertest die Veränderung über alle hinweg. Der Weg von der Beobachtung zur Änderung ist kurz, vieles geht am selben Tag live. Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Data und Engineering: Für Themen, die tiefer in der Pipeline liegen, arbeitest du eng mit den Fachbereichen zusammen. Was du nicht selbst umsetzen kannst, übersetzt du in fundierte Anforderungen an Engineering und Data – mit Beispielen, Zahlen und einer klaren Priorisierung. Neue Shops, neue Daten: Du begleitest die Partneranbindung, prüfst, was die Antwortqualität wirklich trägt, und sagst klar, wenn ein Sortiment noch nicht live gehen sollte. Kategorie-Management ist dein Schlüssel: Kategorien, Attribute und Facetten entscheiden mit darüber, was der Assistent über ein Produkt überhaupt weiß – und weil semantische Ähnlichkeit allein nicht reicht, sobald es um Maße, Kompatibilität oder harte Grenzen geht, legst du hier selbst mit Hand an. Deine Stärken Du kannst relevante Berufserfahrung im E-Commerce, im Produktmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle vorweisen, in der du ein Produkt wirklich vorangetrieben und nicht nur begleitet hast Eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität zeichnet dich aus – du willst Dinge selbst bauen und live sehen, statt sie zu delegieren und nachzuhalten Mit Sprachmodellen hast du über gelegentliches Prompting hinaus praktisch gearbeitet: Du hast Prompts systematisch verbessert, Ergebnisse verglichen und weißt, wo diese Systeme kippen – idealerweise mit Lösungen wie Claude, ChatGPT oder Gemini Durch dein Gespür für Nutzerbedürfnisse erkennst du, was hinter einer Anfrage steckt und wann eine Antwort nur oberflächlich passt Du überzeugst durch eine selbstständige, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise und hast Lust, deine Ideen aktiv im Team einzubringen Technisch bist du anschlussfähig: Du liest eine API-Antwort, verstehst eine Datenstruktur und hast keine Scheu vor SQL – programmieren musst du nicht, selbst anpacken schon Erfahru

jobs.title: Business Analyst (Product-Focused)
jobs.description: Business Analyst (Product-Focused) Do you have a structured, analytical mindset with a passion for user experience and well-functioning systems? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment where your work directly shapes how a product is built and improved? If so, we want to hear from you! Codekeeper is accepting applications for the next two months and will fill the position as soon as we’ve found the perfect match. Job Description As a Business Analyst with a strong product & design capability, your primary focus will be translating business requirements, customer needs, and internal processes into clear product specifications and intuitive user experiences. You will ensure that product decisions are logically sound, well-structured, and aligned with broader company goals. You’ll work at the intersection of business analysis, product management, design, and development - bridging the gap between structured requirements and seamless digital experiences. Key Responsibilities Ensure a well-thought-out, logically structured, and functional product. Translate business and customer requirements into clear specifications for development. Define and document user flows, system logic, edge cases, and acceptance criteria. Make use of the ShadCN design library to assemble product screens and components. Collaborate with the Product Manager and/or Creative Director to research, analyse, and prototype new product features. Develop user cases, scenarios, workflows, wireframes, prototypes, and mockups for screens and system flows. Document functional requirements and design guidelines to ensure accurate implementation. You make well-reasoned tradeoffs between customer impact, data complexity, and delivery timelines. Shipped work leads to measurable improvements in how brands and retailers engage with the network. Strong prioritization skills and comfort making tradeoffs with incomplete information. Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to tailor messages for technical teams, senior stakeholders, and customers alike. Familiarity with Agile product development practices and modern product tooling. Even better if you have, but not required: Experience building or owning reporting, BI, or dashboa

This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey. Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio. What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation. About the Role This is a dedicated role on a single account, helping a key client bring a brand new product to market, with Darkroom owning all media channels. You are the operational owner of that engagement: the person accountable for the program running on time, in scope, and against every commitment, with no slips in timeline. That makes this different from a typical agency PM job. You are not coordinating a portfolio. You are going deep on one enterprise client, holding the operating rhythm, and creating accountability within the layers of Darkroom. You will report to the Director of Growth Strategy on the Hark engagement, with a dotted line to the Managing Director, Paid Media. You maintain Darkroom’s side of the jointly held media plan, forecast, and ramp model, keep it reconciled against actuals, and manage the cadence with the client’s team so both sides are always working off the same numbers. Scope and budget control. You own hours tracking, scope-versus-delivered reconciliation, and ensuring we stay within scope. The operating rhythm. Standups, client status calls, internal syncs, QBR prep. Decisions, action items, and blockers documented and visible to both sides. Cross-functional handoffs. Briefs, assets, performance reporting, and campaign builds moving between Media, Creative, and Analytics on schedule, with dependencies mapped. Resourcing and capacity. Working with the Director of Growth Strategy and team leads to keep staffing matched to the work, and surfacing capacity risk before it shows up as a slipped deadline. Risk escalation. You are the point of escalation for cross-team dependencies and you keep stakeholders aligned without routing every conversation through leadership. You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You You have 3-5+ years of project or program management experience, ideally at a media, marketing, creative, or digital agency You’re conversant in paid media workflows and terminology: campaign builds, flight dates, creative rotations, repor

This is a tactical, execution-focused role: the Product Owner owns the backlog for a defined product area, works day-to-day with development and design, and ensures that what gets built matches what customers and the business need most. Acting as the primary connection point between the Product Manager’s vision and the development team’s execution, the Product Owner combines strong product domain knowledge with hands-on agile delivery experience. Gather and synthesize input from Sales, Customer Success, Support, and customers to inform backlog refinement, and support the Product Manager with market research, competitive analysis, and feature-level requirements. Working understanding of enterprise-scale, cloud-hosted, and SaaS technologies. Preferred Qualifications & Specia

jobs.title: Product Manager - Customer Service Platform
jobs.description: The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify’s subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly. Spotify's Customer Service Platform powers interactions between our users and support teams. As a Product Manager, you will shape the tools, channels, and foundational APIs that enable our advisors to deliver fast, effective, and empathetic support at scale. You’ll help improve the advisor experience through intelligent tooling, define how customers reach support across channels, and strengthen the API layer underpinning our service ecosystem. Your work will bring platform thinking together with real human impact, helping our advisors do their best work and improving how users experience Spotify support.

why_matches: Experience with internal tools and foundational APIs: Arsema has strong background building enterprise workflow platforms, CRM/ERP modules, and internal process tooling (Composity, Bravura).
Technical fluency: Her software engineering background, database concepts, and API testing experience (Postman, Swagger) match the requirement to shape foundational APIs and technical advisor tools.
Data and support analytics: Experience analyzing support tickets to drive root-cause improvements directly maps to improving customer service platforms and advisor experiences.
gaps: Domain gap: Her domain experience is in B2B SaaS (ERP, CRM, eCommerce, EHR, ATS), whereas Spotify's Customer Service Platform operates at massive consumer scale with unique streaming/subscription mechanics.
Scale context: She has built products from 0-to-1 and for mid-market/SME B2B user bases, lacking explicit evidence of managing multi-channel consumer support platforms at a global tech giant level.
jobs.reasoning_summary: Arsema is a strong technical product manager with deep experience in internal tooling, workflow automation, and API-adjacent platforms. While she lacks direct consumer-scale customer service platform experience, her technical background and execution capabilities make her a solid, partial fit for shaping foundational tooling.
